<script lang="ts" module>
  export type InputGroupButtonSize = "sm" | "icon-sm";
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Button } from "$UI$/button";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    children,
    type = "button",
    variant = "ghost",
    size = "sm",
    ...restProps
  }: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof Button>, "href" | "size"> & {
    size?: InputGroupButtonSize;
  } = $props();
</script>

<!-- A button inside the group keeps its own focus indicator. -->
<Button
  bind:ref
  {type}
  data-size={size}
  {variant}
  {size}
  class={cn("text-sm", className)}
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</Button>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Input } from "$UI$/input";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    value = $bindable(),
    class: className,
    ...props
  }: ComponentProps<typeof Input> = $props();
</script>

<!-- The group draws the focus indicator and the border; the control drops both. -->
<Input
  bind:ref
  data-slot="input-group-control"
  class={cn(
    "h-auto flex-1 self-stretch rounded-none border-0 bg-transparent focus-visible:focus-ring-none",
    className,
  )}
  bind:value
  {...props}
/>

<script lang="ts">
  import { getContext } from "svelte";
  import type { HTMLInputAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
  import { cn, type WithElementRef } from "$UTILS$";
  import InputGroupAddon from "./input-group-addon.svelte";
  import InputGroupButton from "./input-group-button.svelte";
  import InputGroupInput from "./input-group-input.svelte";
  import InputGroup from "./input-group.svelte";

  /** The id a `Field` gives its control, under the key "pluto:field" (field decision 11). */
  type FieldContext = { readonly id: string };

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    value = $bindable(),
    class: className,
    id,
    shown = $bindable(false),
    ...restProps
  }: WithElementRef<
    Omit<HTMLInputAttributes, "type" | "files" | "children">
  > & {
    /** Whether the password shows as text. */
    shown?: boolean;
  } = $props();

  const uid = $props.id();
  const field = getContext<FieldContext | undefined>("pluto:field");
  const inputId = $derived(id ?? field?.id ?? `${uid}-password`);
</script>

<!--
  A password input with a Show and Hide toggle. The toggle's name holds its
  visible word (SC 2.5.3), and paste is never blocked. The app sets
  autocomplete: current-password or new-password.
-->
<InputGroup class={className}>
  <InputGroupInput
    bind:ref
    bind:value
    id={inputId}
    type={shown ? "text" : "password"}
    spellcheck={false}
    autocapitalize="off"
    {...restProps}
  />
  <InputGroupAddon align="inline-end">
    <InputGroupButton
      aria-label={shown ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
      aria-controls={inputId}
      class={cn("min-w-16")}
      onclick={() => (shown = !shown)}
    >
      {shown ? "Hide" : "Show"}
    </InputGroupButton>
  </InputGroupAddon>
</InputGroup>
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
  import { Textarea } from "$UI$/textarea";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    value = $bindable(),
    class: className,
    ...props
  }: ComponentProps<typeof Textarea> = $props();
</script>

<!-- The group draws the focus indicator and the border; the control drops both. -->
<Textarea
  bind:ref
  data-slot="input-group-control"
  class={cn(
    "flex-1 resize-none rounded-none border-0 bg-transparent py-2 focus-visible:focus-ring-none",
    className,
  )}
  bind:value
  {...props}
/>
